changelog:
Speech-to-Text (STT) Skill – Initial Release

- Transcribes audio files to text using OpenAI Whisper, optimized for Brazilian Portuguese.
- Supports audio formats: OGG, WAV, MP3, M4A, FLAC, AAC, OPUS.
- Offers transcription with timestamps.
- Provides tools for transcribing individual files, batch processing, and folder monitoring.
- Includes setup instructions and usage examples.
summary: Transcreve arquivos de áudio em português brasileiro para texto, suportando vários formatos e incluindo timestamps.
